Prints Prometheus metrics to STDOUT after rebuilding the selected topology.

# Purpose
This file defines the `metrics` action for the command-line tool. It parses the optional `--topo` argument, uses it to select and rebuild the matching topology through `ACTIONS`, and then prepares the topology in read-only shared-memory mode. After that, it creates an `fd_http_server_t` instance with a large output buffer and calls `fd_prometheus_render_all` to render all Prometheus metrics for the current validator state.

The action then writes the generated metrics text to `STDOUT_FILENO`. The exported `fd_action_metrics` structure registers the action name, argument parser, execution function, and description. This code is a diagnostic action, not a general-purpose library API, and its purpose is to print Prometheus metrics for external collection.
